segments.sn22.120:1.4: Katame ca, bhikkhave, saṃyojaniyā dhammā, katamaṃ saṃyojanaṃ?
segments.sn22.120:1.6: yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn22.120:1.7: Vedanā … pe … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ saṃyojaniyo dhammo;
segments.sn22.120:1.11: yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ.
segments.sn22.120:1.12: Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, saṃyojaniyā dhammā, idaṃ saṃyojanan”ti.
